summary: Comprehensive testing of Driver Duty & Payroll Management App completed. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend UI mostly working with one driver profile association issue identified.

ui_bugs.issue: Driver profile not found error - no proper association between user and driver profile
Form doesn't clear after successful duty entry submission

design_issues.issue: React hydration warnings in console for table structures (tr/span elements)

passed_tests: Admin and driver login with mobile number authentication
Duty entry creation with correct overtime calculation (₹25 per 15 minutes, rounded up)
Food allowance calculation (triggered after standard_hours + 2 hours)
Month/year filtering in duty records and expenses
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix driver profile association in DriverDashboard - currently shows 'Driver profile not found' error because there's no proper link between user accounts and driver profiles. The driver dashboard tries to fetch the first driver from all drivers list rather than finding the driver associated with the logged-in user.
